stem: Which statement best expresses the thesis of the article?

options.label: A
options.text: History should not be buried and ignored but remembered and preserved.

options.label: B
options.text: Historians often make errors in their interpretation of events, a tendency made worse by the damage and loss of historical primary evidence.

options.label: C
options.text: The American Revolution would not have happened without brave men such as Samuel Adams and Paul Revere.

options.label: D
options.text: Time capsules such as the one in the article can be a meaningful record of history, and the surprise of discovery is part of their appeal.
